author: bshastry
content: Prysm may be DoSed by an unprivileged gossip peer that straggles a current-slot unknown beacon root signed envelope with 2.6 million empty transactions. While prysm decodes and validates this envelope, the attacker queues additional signed envelopes for the current slot putting sufficient memory pressure to take down a 32GB prysm node. Can share more details if needed 🙏
